assistant_messages.content:
All three views are ready, built entirely from your documents:

**1. Invoice approval flow (diagram 1)** — From **292-invoice-approval-policy.md**: every supplier invoice is logged the same day, goes through a three-way match against the purchase order and goods receipt note, and is rejected back to the supplier if it doesn't match (resubmissions re-enter the loop; a rejected invoice is never paid). Matching invoices go to the budget holder, who has five working days — after a reminder and a second reminder, the invoice escalates to the head of finance. Anything over €10,000 also needs finance controller sign-off, then accounts payable schedules the next weekly payment run, treasury releases payment on the Thursday run, and everything is filed for audit for seven years. Note the control rule in the policy: nobody may approve an invoice they raised.

**2. Atlas vs Borealis (comparison 1)** — From **292-atlas-msa.md** and **292-borealis-msa.md**: Atlas runs on rolling one-year auto-renewals with a 90-day convenience-termination notice and immediate termination for material breach uncured within 30 days; Borealis is a fixed two-year term (1 June 2024 – 31 May 2026) with a shorter 30-day convenience notice and Company-only immediate termination for Borealis insolvency. On liability, Atlas caps both parties at the trailing 12 months of fees with broad exclusions (death, personal injury, fraud, confidentiality), while Borealis caps its own liability at a fixed €250,000/year and excludes only fraud. The Borealis MSA contains no renewal clause at all — worth attention since its term ended on 31 May 2026.

**3. Atlas contract timeline (timeline 1)** — From **292-atlas-msa.md**: signature on 14 March 2023, services from 1 April 2023, Amendment 1 in February 2024, an SLA breach notice in November 2024 followed by €18,400 in service credits in January 2025, and a 3.1% price uplift in April 2026. **Heads-up: the renewal notice deadline is 15 December 2026 — about seven weeks away.** If you don't want the agreement to roll into another one-year term on 15 March 2027, notice must be given by then.
